posts.title: Thank you, Microsoft Edge!
posts.description: In July 2026, Microsoft Edge renewed their sponsorship of Open Web Docs for 2027 with a contribution of 250,000 USD. Microsoft have sponsored Open Web Docs from the very beginning: this is the seventh consecutive year that they have made such a major contribution to our organization, representing a very substantial proportion of our total funding. posts.title: Web Security docs on MDN
posts.description: Back in September 2025, we announced an investment in Open Web Docs by the Sovereign Tech Agency to create developer documentation on web security and privacy. This month we've completed the biggest section of the commissioned work: to update the web security documentation on MDN. posts.title: Sovereign Tech Fund invests in Web Security and Privacy docs
posts.description: We're proud to share that we're commissioned by the Sovereign Tech Fund to work on expanding developer documentation with security and privacy guidance.
